How to compress JPEG to 100KB?

  1. Click Select Image or drop your photos into the box.
  2. Use Size mode and enter 100 KB. New images start processing automatically.
  3. Change the target or use Slider mode, then click Compress to apply.
  4. Check the original and compressed previews. Each card shows the result size.
  5. Download an individual image or click Download ZIP.

Frequently Asked Questions

Will my image be exactly 100KB?

The goal is 100KB or less, not padding the file to an exact size. Very small targets may not be achievable; the result will say if the target was missed. Here, 1 KB = 1,000 bytes.

Does compression affect image quality?

JPEG and lossy WebP compression can remove detail. A tight size limit may also reduce dimensions. Use Compare before saving, or choose a larger target for more detail.

Can I compress PNG and WebP images too?

Yes. Select the output format in the toolbar. PNG is lossless and ignores the quality slider, so resizing or WebP conversion can give smaller files. Animated images, GIF, SVG and HEIC are not supported.

Are my images uploaded anywhere?

No. Compression runs locally in your browser. The queue disappears when you refresh or close the page. Only your theme preference is saved.

How many images can I select?

Up to 50 images per batch, 25 MB each, 200 MB combined and 40 megapixels per image. Smaller batches work better on phones with limited memory.
